description: guard hooks. Logic lives in `scripts/guard_hook.py`; see `dev/design.md` for the design.

hooks.description: Name the file this turn's answer is written to, so the audit has something editable to correct. Silent when every agent is off, when the session is muted, and on guard's own control commands. guard keeps no copy of the prompt.

When the user APPROVES a plan, hold it before it is built until it has been through the plan audit, and again whenever it is revised afterwards. Choosing "tell Claude what to change" runs no tool, so this never fires on feedback. Silent while the session has plan audits muted (`guard-plan off`, the default).

Record a source file, an agent instruction file, or a saved reference written this turn (for a comment-corrector, agents-md-auditor or ext-docs-auditor dispatch) — a subagent's writes included — and require a file saved inside the refs dir to be listed in the refs index (AGENTS.md).

Mark the finished turn as the on-demand audit target; when any agent switch is on, ask the main agent to route the turn and dispatch the agents worth running on it; and when the turn wrote a file under the refs dir, name ext-docs-auditor over those files regardless of the switches.

Sweep guard state and turn records past the retention window, export GUARD_PROJECT_DIR and GUARD_REFS_DIR, and state the refs rule as session context — plus the playbook path when any agent is on and the reuse policy when any is set to reuse.

When /clear ends a session, hand its session switches to the session replacing it. Matched on `clear` only: every other reason ends a session that is not being replaced. Writes nothing when both switches are muted.
